The sample contains three particularly difficult groups. The name “Antonio García” refers to at least a photographer active between 1928 and 1941, a councillor documented between 1946 and 1952, and a printer mentioned in posters from the 1930s. “María López” appears both as a letter sender and as an actress, without complete dates. “J. Martínez” may refer to four different people.

Automatic links must require an additional signal beyond the name: occupation, location, compatible date, organization, or relationship with another person. When only an initial exists and no contextual signal is available, the mention will remain unlinked. Entities will not be merged merely because they share a surname and an approximate period.

Diego will create provisional identifiers for differentiated candidates and record the reason for each decision. Mateo will review thirty mentions with the Regional Archive. Unresolved cases will remain as separate mentions to avoid introducing a false identity into the graph.
